extends SceneTree

func _init():
	var ts: TileSet = load("res://assets/tile_set.tres")

	print("tile_size = ", ts.tile_size, " (expect (28, 18))")

	var src: TileSetAtlasSource = ts.get_source(1)
	var expect_nav := [
		Vector2i(0,0), Vector2i(1,0), Vector2i(2,0),
		Vector2i(0,1),
		Vector2i(0,2), Vector2i(1,2),
		Vector2i(0,3), Vector2i(1,3), Vector2i(0,4),
	]
	var expect_no_nav := [Vector2i(1,1), Vector2i(3,0), Vector2i(3,1), Vector2i(3,2)]
	var expected_poly := PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-14, -9), Vector2(-14, 9), Vector2(14, 9), Vector2(14, -9)])
	var ok := true
	for coords in expect_nav:
		var td := src.get_tile_data(coords, 0)
		var np: NavigationPolygon = td.get_navigation_polygon(0)
		if np == null:
			print("FAIL: tile ", coords, " missing nav polygon")
			ok = false
			continue
		var verts: PackedVector2Array = np.vertices
		var polys: Array = []
		for i in range(np.get_polygon_count()):
			polys.append(np.get_polygon(i))
		var verts_ok: bool = verts == expected_poly
		var polys_ok: bool = polys.size() == 1 and polys[0] == PackedInt32Array([0, 1, 2, 3])
		print("tile ", coords, ": verts_ok=", verts_ok, " polys_ok=", polys_ok, " verts=", verts)
		if not (verts_ok and polys_ok):
			ok = false
	for coords in expect_no_nav:
		var td := src.get_tile_data(coords, 0)
		var np: NavigationPolygon = td.get_navigation_polygon(0)
		var has: bool = np != null and np.get_polygon_count() > 0
		print("tile ", coords, ": has_nav=", has, " (expect false) np=", np)
		if has:
			ok = false
	print("probabilities: 0:3=", src.get_tile_data(Vector2i(0,3), 0).probability,
		" 1:3=", src.get_tile_data(Vector2i(1,3), 0).probability,
		" 0:4=", src.get_tile_data(Vector2i(0,4), 0).probability)
	if not (src.get_tile_data(Vector2i(0,3), 0).probability == 0.25
			and src.get_tile_data(Vector2i(1,3), 0).probability == 0.25
			and src.get_tile_data(Vector2i(0,4), 0).probability == 0.25):
		ok = false
	print("ALL OK: ", ok)
	quit()
